passage.title: Original practice poem 'The Night Cleaner', written for Tarbiyyah Global Academy
paras: When the office empties, she arrives,
a key on a string, a trolley that squeaks
its one complaint down every corridor.
She knows each desk by its habits:
the one with crumbs, the one with photographs,
the one that never says thank you.
By two the floors are mirrors.
She sees herself in them, briefly,
At dawn the city floods in
and walks across her without looking down.
The floor holds still. It knows who made it clean.
